name: Kyousei AV Debut Kamiki Airi 1X-sai ~Jii Tousatsu kara Hajimatta, Chijoku to Haishin no Hibi~
original_name: 強制AVデビュー 上木愛莉1X歳 ～自慰盗撮から始まった、恥辱と背信の日々～
source:
Summer was starting, and Airi Kamiki's thoughts lingered on a certain boy. Being on the league he was preoccupied with big last game of the season. It wasn't a good time to advance their relationship. She understood this. But her heart ached.

One day, Airi did the favor of picking up some of his clothes from class. In the late afternoon in the empty school building, she smelled his clothes and felt a rush. It was the scent of the boy she liked. Like an opiate...

Just this once, just once, Airi lost a grip on her self-control. But just once was enough to change her life completely. 

[From [url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/announce/=/product_id/RE175431.html]DLsite English[/url]]
translation:
夏天即将开始，神木爱莉的思绪萦绕在某个男孩身上。他正忙于联赛赛季的最后一场重要比赛，现在并不是推进两人关系的好时机。她理解这一点，但心里仍然隐隐作痛。

某天，爱莉帮忙把他的衣服从教室里取走。傍晚时分，空无一人的校舍中，她闻着他的衣服，感到一阵冲动。那是她喜欢的男孩的气味，宛如鸦片……

这一次，就这一次，爱莉失去了自制力。然而，仅仅一次就足以彻底改变她的人生。

[来源：[url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/announce/=/product_id/RE175431.html]DLsite英文版[/url]]
